changes: Copied harness settings use the declared canonical OAuth resource on every hostname; malformed or unavailable discovery offers no copyable endpoint.
Quickstart checks distinguish expired credentials and service outages, and the saved renewal and real-client OAuth checks are integrated.
The Stripe reader uses Invoice.status after the pinned API removed Invoice.paid. Paid renewals retain bounded access during the draft interval; cancellation and failed payment remain separate.
Concurrent billing deliveries preserve unknown versus pending outcomes. No billing policy or live Stripe object was changed.

local_checks.website_snapshot_limit: The broad local browser run started before the billing integration; its hashes are an end-of-run snapshot. Exact integration CI and frozen-source live checks passed separately.

additional_stripe_failed_renewal_attempt.outcome: stopped at a second sandbox authentication challenge before payment; test session read back open and unpaid with no subscription

subsequent_capacity_change.limit: Storage-only increment at the published rate; traffic and changed snapshot bytes remain metered separately. No increase to the recorded budget was made.

limits: The million-file publication is not live. Its retrieval and metadata repairs still need exact current-base reconciliation.
Two offerings and opt-in intelligence updates are a new owner direction, not available plans or a notification service in this release.
Cloudflare's existing management connection and R2 Worker probe work, but production serving has not migrated.
No live charge, new account, new price, DNS cutover, public plugin listing or legal-notice change was made.
